source_notes: Representative standard-tier re-verify for the Tanzania LNG Terminal project (Lindi/Likong'o). As of Jan-Apr 2026 reporting the Host Government Agreement / legal framework is still UNSIGNED (targeted before June 2026) and FID is still pending (window 2028-2029, first gas early 2030s). Project remains correctly pre-FID / proposed; capacity (10 mtpa total / 5 mtpa per train), $42bn cost, and the six-partner consortium (Equinor, Shell, ExxonMobil, Medco, Pavilion Energy, TPDC) all remain consistent with GEM. No GEM field cleanly differs.
scope_note: Project-level re-verify; applies to both units T1 (G100002026301) and T2 (G100002026302). Recorded once per the standard-tier 'one representative blue re-verify per terminal' rule rather than blue-marking every field.
